alt: 四名球員曾在落敗後沮喪坐在球門旁，如今重新整隊、備妥裝備，昂首一同回到球場。
scene_prompt: Meaning: after defeat or failure, people reorganize and return to try again. Four youth soccer teammates step together from the sideline back onto the field for a new match, focused and united; one carries the ball and another secures a teammate's plain captain armband. A sepia snapshot beside the equipment bench shows the same four dejected after an earlier defeat. Neatly arranged cones, bottles and boots show disciplined rebuilding. The contrast makes previous defeat and confident return unmistakable.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks, brand marks, speech bubbles, or recognizable existing characters. Modern everyday setting. Delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor washes, colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper; restrained natural colors, no glossy rendering or 3D.
